name: Language Training Visa
description: The D-4 visa is for foreign nationals enrolled in Korean language programs at universities or accredited language institutes. It allows students to study Korean while experiencing life in Korea.
keyRequirement: Acceptance to accredited Korean language program
targetAudience: Students wanting to learn Korean language
Those preparing for university study in Korea

restrictions: Limited part-time work (20 hours/week during semester)
workPermission.notes: Must maintain student status and good attendance

pathsTo.name: Student Visa
pathsTo.requirements: Complete Korean language program and gain admission to a Korean university degree program.
pathsTo.notes: The natural progression from language study to degree study. Apply to universities while still in your language program. Higher TOPIK scores from D-4 study improve university admission chances.

pathsTo.name: Job Seeking Visa
pathsTo.requirements: Must have bachelor's degree from a previous institution. Apply before D-4 expires.
pathsTo.notes: For language students who already have a degree and want to seek Korean employment. Korean language skills gained from D-4 study are a major advantage in the job market.

pathsFrom.name: Working Holiday Visa
pathsFrom.requirements: Enroll in an accredited Korean language program. Apply before H-1 expires.
pathsFrom.notes: Some Working Holiday visa holders transition to language study to improve their Korean before pursuing employment or university admission.
